Role.description_en:
The role permissions granted to the account for the database. For MySQL mode, roles are at the database level and include the following types:
ReadWrite: Read and write permissions, including ALL PRIVILEGES.
ReadOnly: Read-only permissions, including SELECT.
DDL: DDL permissions, including CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, and CREATE VIEW.
DML: DML permissions, including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and SHOW VIEW
Role.description_zh:
账号赋予该库的角色权限。
对于 MySQL 模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其有以下几类：  
ReadWrite：读写权限，包括 ALL PRIVILEGES；  
ReadOnly：只读权限，包括 SELECT；
DDL: DDL权限，包括CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW；  
DML: DML权限，包括SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW
Role.title_zh: 账号赋予该库的角色权限。 对于MySQL模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其有以下几类： - ReadWrite：读写权限，包括ALL PRIVILEGES； - ReadOnly：只读权限，包括SELECT - DDL: DDL权限，包括CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW - DML: DML权限，包括SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
